restorationLadder.framing: Admission slots are Tyr-local and can be taken back from a borrower by an expiring deadline (enforced). Upstream token capacity cannot be reclaimed once in flight at the provider: an unlent slice is withheld before lending (allocation-enforced), and everything else is a wall-clock objective. Tyr reports upstream cancellation as unverified and this benchmark never restates it as reclaimed capacity.
